POSITION SUMMARY

The Supply Management BI Analyst will serve as dedicated BI support to the Babcock Power Inc. Supply Management Department. The position will report within the IT department with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Director of Global Sourcing.

The Supply Management BI Analyst role will be responsible for developing analytics, dashboards, and data models that provide insight into supplier performance, sourcing strategies, cost drivers, tariff exposure, and supply chain risk across Babcock Power’s global operations. The BI Analyst will work at the direction of the Supply Management leadership team to transform data into actionable intelligence that supports strategic sourcing initiatives, supplier development, and operational efficiency.

A key early effort will be structuring and categorizing commodity inputs across major product groups, establishing a foundational dataset that identifies which products are exposed to specific commodities and regions, and to what extent.
